categories.main_business_segments: CTSC (CTS Co., Ltd.) operates two main business segments: the Digital Data Service (DDS) business and the Surveying Measurement System (SMS) business. The DDS segment provides integrated ICT solutions for construction sites, including cloud storage, video, communication, and network services, mainly through the 'Site Assist Package.' The SMS segment offers rental and sales of surveying and measurement systems, such as MDTs and GNSS-based one-person surveying systems. There is also a smaller 'Other' segment, which includes smart house rentals for construction sites and specialized road signage work.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies center on integrating ICT and digital solutions for construction site management, including cloud-based data storage, remote video monitoring, and communication platforms. The DDS business leverages cloud computing, networked devices, and multi-functional displays, while the SMS business utilizes advanced surveying technologies such as GNSS and MDT systems. Rental assets are managed and maintained centrally, and the company invests in updating its rental fleet to meet evolving customer needs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CTSC primarily serves civil engineering and construction companies, targeting both corporate headquarters and on-site operations. Its main customers are domestic general contractors, especially regional mid-sized firms, and public sector entities for infrastructure and disaster prevention projects. The company is highly focused on the Japanese construction industry, with no significant overseas sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates exclusively in Japan, with a nationwide network of branches and service centers covering all major regions, including Hokkaido, Tohoku, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, Chugoku, Shikoku, and Kyushu/Okinawa. All sales and assets are located within Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: CTSC operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, acting as a solution integrator and service provider to construction companies. It procures equipment and ICT solutions from upstream technology partners and delivers value-added rental, sales, and support services directly to end users at construction sites.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on transforming from a hardware-centric rental business to a provider of integrated digital and information services for construction productivity. Key initiatives include expanding the DDS business, promoting the Site Assist Package, strengthening sales and marketing functions, and developing new markets such as public sector monitoring. While there is no formal R&D division, the company invests in service development and digital transformation to support construction industry DX (digital transformation) and productivity improvement.
categories.revenue_model: CTSC generates revenue primarily through the rental and sale of ICT equipment and surveying systems, as well as subscription-based cloud and digital services. The DDS business increasingly emphasizes recurring revenue from integrated service packages and subscriptions, while the SMS business combines equipment rental with direct sales. Additional revenue comes from smart house rentals and specialized construction services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors include other construction ICT solution providers, surveying equipment rental companies, and firms offering digital transformation services to the construction industry. CTSC positions itself as a specialist in construction ICT, with a strong focus on integrated digital site support and a nationwide sales/service network. The company is recognized for its expertise and customer base in the Japanese construction sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending March 2025, CTSC reported consolidated sales of 11.8 billion yen and net income of 2.19 billion yen, with a workforce of 278 employees. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with sales increasing by 6.6% and net income by 17.8% year-on-year. The medium-term plan targets further growth, aiming for sales of 12.8 billion yen and an operating margin above 25% by FY2026.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CTSC differentiates itself by offering integrated, construction-specific digital solutions that enhance productivity, safety, and remote management at job sites. Its value proposition lies in combining ICT, cloud, and measurement technologies into user-friendly packages tailored for the construction industry, supported by a nationwide service network and deep industry expertise. The company emphasizes its ability to address labor shortages, regulatory changes, and the digital transformation needs of construction clients.
